visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing an elegant sleeveless blue halter-neck dress with a high slit, stands centered on an outdoor rooftop or parking lot. She holds a silver transverse flute horizontally to her lips, poised to play. Above her head, a digital musical score is overlaid against the building background, and a large yellow box in the center contains the text 'If "Die with a Smile" has a flute solo...'. The background consists of concrete flooring and grey industrial-looking buildings with large white pipes under a flat, overcast sky. (2) The woman begins playing the flute, her fingers moving rapidly and precisely over the silver keys while she sways her body gently to the music's rhythm. Her facial expression is focused, with a slight smile as she looks toward the camera. The camera cuts between a medium full shot and a closer medium shot, highlighting the metallic texture of the instrument and the vibrant blue of her dress. The lighting is soft and natural, providing even coverage across the urban setting. (3) The performance continues into a solo section where a lightbulb icon and text overlay appear on the right side offering a 'Repertoire Hint'. The woman maintains a professional posture, with the digital sheet music still visible at the top. Near the end, the text 'To be continued' appears at the bottom of the frame. She finishes a musical phrase and gazes directly into the camera, while the urban background remains static and the lighting consistent.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-fidelity pop/soul master track featuring a prominent drum beat and piano chords. A female vocalist sings with high emotional intensity. Layered cleanly on top is a live flute performance, displaying a bright, airy timbre and rapid melodic runs that mirror the vocal lines. The mix is professionally balanced with high spectral brightness. (2) As the music progresses, the primary vocals continue, but the flute melody becomes more intricate, performing a solo-style counter-melody. The tempo remains a steady 110 BPM. There is no audible environmental noise, indicating a studio-quality production environment where the flute's transients are sharp and the harmonic clarity is high. (3) The background pop track abruptly fades or cuts, leaving a solo flute melody. This new section features a slower tempo and a shift in musical mode to a more classical style. The acoustic atmosphere is one of 'StudioSilence', focusing entirely on the flute's tone. The notes are long and sustained, showing excellent control and tonal purity before the recording ends.
